articles.title: Pakistan jet downed in Jalalabad as Kabul–Islamabad clash spirals toward war
articles.summary: A Pakistani fighter jet recently crashed in Afghanistan's Jalalabad region, leading to the capture of its pilot by Afghan military and police. This incident marks a dramatic escalation in the ongoing confrontation between the two nations. For SSB aspirants, understanding such cross-border military incidents is crucial for analyzing regional security dynamics and their broader implications for international relations.

articles.title: Sonic booms to drone spectacle: IAF showcases firepower at Vayu Shakti 2026 (Photos)
articles.summary: The Indian Air Force (IAF) recently showcased its formidable firepower at the Vayu Shakti 2026 exercise. The grand display featured a thrilling array of capabilities, from powerful sonic booms generated by fighter jets to an impressive, coordinated drone spectacle. This exercise underscores the IAF's advanced operational readiness and commitment to modernizing its aerial defence capabilities, vital for national security and strategic deterrence.

articles.title: HC lifts stay, clears path for ‘Kerala Story 2’ release
articles.summary: Abu Dhabi has rolled out a new public health policy to aggressively tackle obesity rates among its population. A key component of this initiative includes a ban on junk food advertising and a mandate for billboards to promote sugar-free products. This forward-thinking move by the UAE capital aims to encourage healthier eating habits and lifestyles, setting a significant precedent for global urban health strategies.

articles.title: SA Greens unfazed by polling, sticking to their guns on AUKUS
articles.summary: Ahead of the South Australian state election in three weeks, minor parties are experiencing a significant surge in polling, indicating a dramatic shift in voter preferences. This development challenges traditional political dynamics and suggests a potentially unpredictable outcome. The focus is on understanding the issues driving this change as the state prepares for its crucial electoral test.
